create_VideoCompression: create a VideoCompression module to simulate video artifacts by compressing and decompressing frames with a specified codec and CRF
test_SpeedChange: test the SpeedChange augmenter to adjust video playback speed by duplicating or dropping frames
refactor_TemporalReorder: refactor the TemporalReorder augmenter to randomly reorder small chunks of frames for temporal discontinuities
run_WindowAveraging: run the WindowAveraging augmenter to apply temporal averaging over a sliding window of video frames
review_DropFrame: review the DropFrame augmenter that randomly replaces frames with adjacent ones using a configurable probability
